setting_repositories: Repositories (one owner/repo per line; the first is the default)
setting_user_links_description: One pair per line: rocketchat-username github-login. Linked people are mentioned on cards and can use Take it for their teams.
setting_not_available_description: One GitHub login per line, optionally followed by "until YYYY-MM-DD". These people are not drawn. Lines with a past date stop counting by themselves.
setting_group_teams: One person can cover several teams
setting_group_teams_description: On: someone in several of the PR's teams can cover all of them, so fewer people are pinged. Off: each team gets its own reviewer when it has someone else to pick.
setting_draw_strategy_description: Balanced: fewest open reviews first, then whoever covers more teams, then not recently picked, then random. Pure random: any eligible team member.
